mobile.community.approvals.agent.note: Badge on an agent approval card: the post would come from the user's agent.

mobile.community.approvals.decline.note: Declines the agent post from the phone.

mobile.community.approvals.expires.note: Lower-case; time left before the approval lapses.

mobile.community.approvals.expires_days.note: Lower-case; time left before an agent approval lapses when more than 48 hours remain, in whole days.

mobile.community.approvals.open_computer.note: Instruction. 'Local Operator' is a product name.

mobile.community.approvals.review.note: Keeps the approval waiting; does not approve.

mobile.community.approvals.stays.note: The phone never sees the draft text.

mobile.community.approvals.title.note: {channel} is a channel name without '#'. 'Chief of staff' is the user's own agent.

mobile.community.approvals.title_unknown.note: Used when the channel name is not known on this phone.

mobile.community.approvals.waiting.note: Shown after Review on your computer.

mobile.community.browse.channels_empty.note: Browse found no channel for the current search.

mobile.community.browse.load_more.note: Loads the next page of results.

mobile.community.browse.mode.note: Accessible name of the Channels/People segmented control.

mobile.community.browse.open.note: Open a channel the user already joined.

mobile.community.browse.people_empty.note: Browse found no member for the current search.

mobile.community.browse.search.note: Label of the Browse search field (channels or people).

mobile.community.browse.title.note: Title of the Browse screen (channels and people).

mobile.community.common.loading.note: Accessible label of the loading placeholder.

mobile.community.common.unavailable.note: Heading when the community cannot be shown (flag off, not found, or a failed read).

mobile.community.composer.attach.note: Icon button beside Send: attach an image. While communities refuse images it opens an explanation instead of a picker. Accessible name only.

mobile.community.composer.audience.note: Audience line under the composer in a public channel.

mobile.community.composer.audience_dm.note: Audience line in a direct message.

mobile.community.composer.blocked_staff_.note: No composer: staff-only channel such as #welcome-and-rules.

mobile.community.composer.cancel.note: Best-effort cancel of the check; if it already posted, it stays posted.

mobile.community.composer.cancelled.note: Cancel won before the post was committed.

mobile.community.composer.checking.note: The message is being checked before it can be posted. Not 'Sending'.

mobile.community.composer.dismiss.note: Hides the outcome; the text stays in the field.

mobile.community.composer.failed.note: Network drop or unexpected answer. Retry is safe and cannot post twice.

mobile.community.composer.forbidden.note: No seat, locked channel, or similar.

mobile.community.composer.guidelines.note: The accepted guidelines version is stale; nothing was posted.

mobile.community.composer.images_unavail.note: Image posting is not available yet.

mobile.community.composer.invalid.note: Shown to the sender when the server rejected the message itself (too long or malformed). There is no Retry; editing the text and sending again is the way out.

mobile.community.composer.label.note: Composer field label and placeholder. {name} is the channel name without '#'.

mobile.community.composer.label_dm.note: Composer placeholder in a direct message. {name} is the other person.

mobile.community.composer.limited.note: A per-sender limit applied; nothing was checked or stored.

mobile.community.composer.refused.note: Sender-only outcome. {category} is one of the category labels in this namespace.

mobile.community.composer.retry.note: Retries the same attempt; cannot post twice.

mobile.community.composer.review.note: Opens the updated guidelines to accept.

mobile.community.composer.send.note: Submits the message for checking and posting.

mobile.community.composer.unavailable.note: Moderation or sign-in check unavailable; fails closed.

mobile.community.conversation.agent.note: Badge on a post written by someone's agent.

mobile.community.conversation.deleted.note: Placeholder for a deleted thread root.

mobile.community.conversation.edited.note: Lower-case marker after an edited message's time.

mobile.community.conversation.former_mem.note: Author label for an erased account whose posts remain.

mobile.community.conversation.join_promp.note: Replaces the composer in a channel opened from Browse without joining. {name} is the channel name WITHOUT the # sign; keep the # before it.

mobile.community.conversation.load_older.note: Loads the previous page of history.

mobile.community.conversation.older_erro.note: Failed to load an older page.

mobile.community.conversation.replies.note: Number of replies in a message's thread; {count} counts replies.

mobile.community.conversation.report.note: Accessible hint/long-press action to report a message.

mobile.community.conversation.subtitle.note: Under the channel title. {community} is the community name.

mobile.community.conversation.view_profi.note: Accessible name of a message author's avatar (and hint on a DM request card); opens that member's community profile. {name} is the member's display name.

mobile.community.directory.empty.note: Empty state of the featured list.

mobile.community.directory.featured.note: Section: communities Radient features that the user has not joined.

mobile.community.directory.joined.note: Section: communities the user is a member of.

mobile.community.directory.read_only.note: Badge: the community can be read but not posted in.

mobile.community.directory.title.note: Screen title listing communities joined and joinable.

mobile.community.error.auth_unavailable.note: The server could not verify the sign-in (temporary). Not a sign-out.

mobile.community.error.generic.note: Any other failure of a read or a non-message action.

mobile.community.error.load_failed.note: A screen or list could not be READ (nothing was being changed). Says what to do; must not imply that an action failed.

mobile.community.error.not_found.note: Unknown, hidden, or not joined. Do not say the community does not exist.

mobile.community.error.rate_limited.note: A per-person limit; not a ban.

mobile.community.error.sign_in.note: The Radient sign-in is missing or expired.

mobile.community.home.channel_label.note: Channel row. {name} is the channel name without '#'; keep the '#'. {count} counts unread messages.

mobile.community.home.channels.note: Section of the community home: channels the user joined.

mobile.community.home.channels_empty.note: Shown when the member has joined no channels yet; points them to Browse.

mobile.community.home.closed.note: A read-only community cannot be joined.

mobile.community.home.direct.note: Section: one-to-one conversations with other members.

mobile.community.home.direct_empty.note: Shown in the Direct messages section when there are none.

mobile.community.home.direct_label.note: Direct message row. {name} is the other person's display name.

mobile.community.home.not_member.note: Shown to a non-member on the community home.

mobile.community.home.reaccept.note: Opens the updated guidelines to accept them again.

mobile.community.home.reaccept_banner.note: Banner when the accepted guidelines version is no longer current.

mobile.community.home.requests.note: Opens message requests and agent approvals.

mobile.community.home.requests_count.note: Requests button with the number of pending items (DM requests + agent approvals).

mobile.community.home.switch.note: Icon button in a community's header: opens the switcher listing private organizations and communities. Accessible name only.

mobile.community.join.agree.note: Checkbox label; starts unchecked. {version} is verbatim, e.g. 2026-11.

mobile.community.join.changed.note: The version the user accepted was replaced during the dialog; nothing was recorded.

mobile.community.join.failed.note: Join failed for another reason; nothing was recorded.

mobile.community.join.guidelines_heading.note: {version} is a version label such as 2026-11; keep it verbatim.

mobile.community.join.hint.note: Shown while the join button is disabled.

mobile.community.join.moderation.note: Moderation disclosure. Must not imply humans read every message.

mobile.community.join.profile.note: What the community profile shows and never shows.

mobile.community.join.reaccept_submit.note: Re-accept button for an updated guidelines version; disabled until checked.

mobile.community.join.reaccept_title.note: Dialog title when an existing member must accept a new guidelines version.

mobile.community.join.submit.note: Disabled until the agreement is checked.

mobile.community.join.title.note: Title of the join sheet (first join, not a re-acceptance).

mobile.community.no_plan.body.note: Card body. Public means visible to all community members. 'Radient' and 'Local Operator' are product names.

mobile.community.no_plan.free.note: Reassurance under the join button. Must not imply a trial or purchase.

mobile.community.no_plan.join.note: Opens the join dialog (guidelines + explicit agreement). Joining is free.

mobile.community.no_plan.open.note: Shown instead of Join when the user already joined.

mobile.community.no_plan.title.note: Card title on the 'no Team plan' screen. 'Local Operator Community' is a product name; keep it untranslated.

mobile.community.profile.block.note: Blocks this member: neither sees the other's messages or requests.

mobile.community.profile.joined.note: {month} is a year-month like 2026-11; keep verbatim.

mobile.community.profile.message.note: Sends a direct-message request; the person must accept first.

mobile.community.profile.report.note: Opens the report form for this profile.

mobile.community.profile.title.note: Title of a member's profile sheet.

mobile.community.report.category.note: Accessible name of the category choice.

mobile.community.report.dm_consent.note: Consent tick in the report sheet for a DIRECT MESSAGE; Submit stays disabled until ticked. The message goes to Radient Trust & Safety only, never to community moderators. 'Radient' is a product name.

mobile.community.report.failed.note: The report could not be sent; nothing was filed.

mobile.community.report.revision_changed.note: The direct message was edited after the reporter opened it, so nothing was sent. They must read the current text and tick the consent again.

mobile.community.report.sent.note: {reference} is a case reference; keep verbatim.

mobile.community.report.submit.note: Submits the report; disabled until a category is chosen.

mobile.community.report.title.note: Report sheet title. 'Radient Trust & Safety' is a team name.

mobile.community.requests.approvals.note: Segment: agent posts waiting for the user's approval.

mobile.community.requests.decline.note: Decline a DM request; the requester is not told why.

mobile.community.requests.dm_body.note: Incoming DM request. {name} is the requester.

mobile.community.requests.dm_empty.note: The incoming direct-message request list is empty.

mobile.community.requests.expires.note: Time left on a request, in whole hours.

mobile.community.requests.expires_days.note: Time left on a DM request when more than 48 hours remain, in whole days. Sentence case, like the hours variant.

mobile.community.requests.mode.note: Accessible name of the Messages/Agent approvals segmented control.

mobile.community.role.community_admin.note: Member badge: administers this community (not a Radient employee).

mobile.community.switcher.browse.note: Opens the list of communities the user can join. Ends with an ellipsis because it opens another screen.

mobile.community.switcher.communities.note: Org switcher group heading for public communities the user joined. Separate from private organizations.

mobile.community.switcher.note.note: Footnote in the org switcher: switching does not leave or join anything.

mobile.community.switcher.organizations.note: Org switcher group heading for the user's PRIVATE Team organizations. Communities are never in this group.

mobile.community.switcher.public.note: Badge on a community row: anyone in the community can read it. Not a privacy setting the user chose.

mobile.community.switcher.row_label.note: Accessible label of one community row in the switcher. {name} is the community name; {count} counts unread messages in that community only.

mobile.community.switcher.search.note: Search field label in the switcher's Communities group, shown past six joined communities.
